user.title: Connect to your RTLS@Home engine
user.description: The engine turns the Bluetooth sightings Home Assistant collects into rooms and positions. Enter its address and the ingest token you gave it.

data_description.token: The shared secret the engine was started with (RTLS_INGEST_TOKEN).

hassio_confirm.title: Connect to the RTLS@Home App
hassio_confirm.description: The RTLS@Home App is running on this Home Assistant. Connect the integration to it?

hassio_move.title: Move RTLS@Home to the App
hassio_move.description: RTLS@Home is connected to the engine at {current}. The RTLS@Home App is now running on this Home Assistant. Move the integration to the App? Every device and sensor keeps its name, id and history.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the engine at that address.
error.unsupported_version: The engine speaks a different protocol version. Update RTLS@Home or the engine.

abort.invalid_discovery: The RTLS@Home App announced itself without an address or token.
